div.head: I Cn 2.1
div.ab: Ælc cyrice is mid rihte on Cristes agenan griðe; ⁊ ælc Cristen man ah mycele þearfe, þæt he on þam griðe mycele mæðe wite; forðam Godes grið is ealra griða selost to geearnigenne ⁊ geornost to healdenne, ⁊ þær nehst cininges.

Ælc cyrice is mid rihte on Cristes aganan gryðe; ⁊ ælc Crysten man ah mycele þearfe, þæt he on þam gryðe mycele mæðe wite; forðam Godes gryð is ealra griða selast to geearnianne ⁊ geornnost to healdenne, ⁊ þær nyhst cyninges.

Ælc cirice is mid rihte on Cristes agenan griðe; and ælc Cristen man ah micele þearfe, þæt he on ðam griðe micele mæðe wite; forðam Godes grið is ealra griða selost to geearnianne ⁊ geornost to healdenne, ⁊ þar nihst cynges.

Omnis ęcclesia sub propria Dei omnipotentis protectione consistit; et Christianis omnibus magnam super his reuerentiam exhibere conuenit, quia Dei pax super omnem pacis actionem specialius exoptanda, propensius est obseruanda, et postea regis.

Ælc cyrice is mid rihte on Cristes agenan griðe ⁊ ælc Cristen man ah mycele þearfe þæt he on þam griðe mycele mæðe wite, forðam Godes grið is ealra griða selost to geearnigenne ⁊ geornost to healdenne, ⁊ þær nehst cininges.

Ælc cyrice is, mid rihte, on Cristes agenan griðe, and ælc Cristen man ah mycele þearfe þæt he on þam griðe mycele mæðe wite; forðam Godes grið is ealra griða selost to geearnigenne and geornost to healdenne, and þær nehst cininges.

Every church is rightly in the protection of Christ himself, and it is the special duty of every Christian man to show great respect for that protection, for the protection of God is of all kinds of protection most especially to be sought after and most zealously to be upheld, and next to that the protection of the king.

Every church is, by right, under Christ’s own protection, and every Christian has the particular obligation to show great respect for that protection; for of all forms of protection, the best to be sought and the most faithfully to be respected is the protection of God, and after that the king’s.

Jede Kirche ist rechtmässig in Christi eigenem Sonderschutz; und jeder Christenmensch hat stark die Pflicht, dass er vor diesem Sonderschutze grosse Hochachtung empfinde; denn Gottes Friedensschutz ist unter allen Schutzgewalten am vorzüglichsten zu verdienen und am eifrigsten zu halten; und demnächst der des Königs.

Every church is rightly under Christ's own protection; and every Christian man has great need to show great respect for that protection; for God's protection is of all protections the most to be earned and the most eagerly to be kept, and next to it the king's.
